notes.title: Update Patch Demo AIBTDv2.5.2
notes.notes:
Hello Everyone,

We have exciting news to share in the latest update for As I Began to Dream version 2.5.2!

Responding to numerous requests from our demo players in Indonesia, we are pleased to announce the addition of the Indonesian language to our game demo. Now, all dialogues in the game have been localized for Indonesian players. We hope this update enhances your experience with the As I Began to Dream demo. Don't forget to add it to your wishlist!

In addition to the language addition, this update includes:
Flippy now provides hints if players find difficulty navigating levels.
Enhanced immersion with the addition of Fauna and Flora elements in the game.
New animations for Lily's parents.
New visual effects for various in-game objects.
Improved clarity in certain parts of the game.

Thank you for your attention and support. If you have any feedback or suggestions for our game, feel free to share them on our Steam forum or Discord.
